rule: preregistration.md §6-§7: a challenger failing any of G1-G5 is NOT_ADOPTION_ELIGIBLE; among eligible ones choose fewest spurious certainties / false-confident scales, then most correct printed-and-bound PRIMARY labels, then smallest change; at most one, or NONE

failed: G2 (a' 43, c 4: kosacce x2 +11.18 %, tymianku -7.76 %, sheet S1 registration 77.65 % off TRUE_SCALE)

whatWasLearned: Self-anchoring (CHAIN_CORRECTED values anchoring the scale they were chosen for) is real and widespread (627 anchors at the base) but removing it alone is unsafe: scale-chosen values are consistent with scale-chosen spans; the ink is truer but lands on a span it does not measure (wrong-span promotion).

The order of a future fix must be: span from geometry -> value from ink -> anchor from that value; C4 (C1+C2+C3 side by side) does not implement that order and still fails G1 and has a false-confident scale on S1.

The re-read gate (N1) is a real bottleneck: correct PRIMARY labels 10 -> 32 with no verdict change and no false-confident scale, but it leaves self-anchoring in place (G2a 468) and changes 9 known-good models.

The footprint residual is a weak guard of the scale: registrations moved +45 % to +182 % (rarytasy-g2e, glogownikach, cyklamenach, jarzabem) with the footprint unchanged, because the footprint comes from statements on the grid ladder.
nextStepForOwnerDecision: not tested here: let the ink replace a correction only on a span the label measures geometrically (C2 as a precondition of C1, not beside it), and account for every known-good model change against the drawing rather than a threshold; needs a separately authorised stage
